text:
incident-bot: PAGER — high error rate detected for model:redwood-3b-v2 (canary, us-west-2). 12% model-error > 5% threshold. metric: /inference/errors. runbook: https://go/runbooks/model-canary-fail. paging @oncall-sre

oncall-sre (taylor): Acked. jumping on it. pulling logs now.

maya: I see a spike in tokenization errors in the canary pods: 
```
ERROR: Tokenizer mismatch: token id 50256 not found in vocab mapping
Traceback (most recent calls)...
```

ow: which tokenizer bundle was deployed with the new weights?

owen: The model artifact package includes weights + tokenizer bundle stamped at release 6789. The release job should have pushed token files to /artifacts/models/redwood-3b-v2/6789/tokenizer.*

maya: Checking node env on one failing pod: `kubectl exec -it pod/canary-3b-1 -- printenv | grep TOKENIZER` shows `TOKENIZER_OVERRIDE=legacy-tokenizer-v1` — that looks wrong.

samir: That env var was added yesterday by the rollout job to backfill compat for two internal tests. It should not have been in the canary image.

maya: Confirmed: the canary started with weights for v2 but the env override forced the runtime to use legacy token ids, causing many unknown token IDs and garbage output.

owen: That explains the mismatched tokenizer mapping errors and also the 500s some customers reported.

support-bot: Customer alert: Enterprise customer "Northstar Analytics" reported 500s and truncation on batch runs started 2026-03-15T02:10Z — ticket #CS-4621.

taylor: Ok mitigation plan: 1) Turn off v2 rollout flag (kill-switch) 2) Route traffic away from canary pods to v1 fallback 3) Rollback canary to stable image without env override 4) Postmortem owner assignment.

maya: I can flip the feature flag now in /console/rollouts -> feature: `model_redwood-3b-v2_rollout` set to `off` (canary). Doing it now.

deploy-bot: feature flag `model_redwood-3b-v2_rollout` set to OFF by maya at 2135008023.

owen: I'll update routing rules: add hard fallback to redwood-3b-v1 for any errors > 3% and immediately scale v1 pool to handle 2x traffic.

(owen runs) `rictl routing set-fallback --model redwood-3b-v1 --for-model redwood-3b-v2 --mode hard`

deploy-bot: routing change applied. v1 target pool scaled to 200% capacity (requested by owen).

maya: I'm patching the canary Deployment to remove the TOKENIZER_OVERRIDE env var and redeploying with correct tokenizer bundle. patch:
```
- name: TOKENIZER_OVERRIDE
  value: legacy-tokenizer-v1
+ # removed unexpected override
```

maya: Patch applied to canary pods at 2135008210, restarting pods.

incident-bot: Deploy event: rollout 6789 -> redeploy triggered by maya. Watch logs for tokenizer load success.

(2m later)

maya: New pod logs show `Loaded tokenizer: redwood-3b-v2-tokenizer-v6789, vocab size 50400` and tokenization errors dropped to 0.5%.

support-bot: Customer ticket updated: Northstar Analytics notified about mitigation and fallback routing. They confirmed degraded results but no longer 500s.

samir: Are any other regions affected or only us-west-2 canary?

owen: Only canary pool in us-west-2 had the env var set — rollout pipeline mistakenly added it when spinning up canary. Production stable pools were untouched.

maya: Root cause (quick): CI job `canary-init` inadvertently injected legacy env via a template variable. The template default changed in 2026-03-14 deploy PR #3456.

taylor: For immediate ops: leave v2 rollout OFF until we validate a clean canary run across zones. I’ll keep incident status open for 2 hours for monitoring.

samir: Assign postmortem: eng-runtime (maya, owen) + eng-oncall (taylor) + infra (deploy pipeline) — owner: owen. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD today.

maya: Quick remediation notes for postmortem: - revert template default in canary-init - add CI check that ensures tokenizer env is absent when model artifact contains tokenizer bundle - add canary smoke test that asserts tokenization roundtrip on first 100 sample inputs.

taylor: Handing off oncall to owen for monitoring window — I need to jump to another page. owen, you're taking primary for next 2h.

owen: taking it. I'll watch canary metrics and customer tickets.

deploy-bot: rollback to redwood-3b-v1 fallback engaged until validated.

maya: Current status: error rate back under SLO (0.7%), canary pods healthy, tokenizer loads correct bundle. Keeping rollout OFF and routing fallback in place.

support-bot: Notifying customers on incident channel: impacted customers list pushed, support messages queued (template sent).

owen: Closing notes: mitigation complete, no broad customer outage. Impact: brief errors for canary-backed routes and specific enterprise batch jobs (~30 min window). Postmortem owner and timeline posted.

samir: Thanks team — we'll follow up with a coordinated release once fix validated. :thumbsup:

(taylor): thanks all, leaving channel.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-20260315-7890.
